official_loss.formula: sum_t weight_t * abs(pred-truth)/(abs(pred)+abs(truth)+epsilon); mean equally over wells; score=100*(1-loss)
official_loss.net_score_contribution: group well fraction times paired within-group score delta against B0

privacy.cross_tab_suppression: all persistent-hard counts/fractions within a dimension suppressed if any group-by-hard-status cell is smaller than five

loss_rank_correlations.method: Spearman correlation of per-well official weighted losses; tied ranks averaged
loss_rank_correlations.undefined_policy: null for a constant loss vector; mean uses only defined split correlations
loss_rank_correlations.interpretation: correlated errors indicate shared hard cases, not a causal mechanism

limitations: all group comparisons are descriptive posthoc error diagnostics, not proof of causal feature effects
groups from different dimensions overlap and their score contributions must not be added
persistent hard cases are selected using B0 outcomes; this selection favors apparent regression toward the mean for other models
no label-based group may be used as a future input, gating variable, or model-routing rule
six splits reuse the same wells and are not six independent datasets
mean summaries average fixed plus five repeated splits, explicitly labeled; they are not the five-repeat selection metric
